mapper.select: SELECT masq.FACTORY_CODE, masq.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, masq.LOCATION_TYPE, masq.BRAND, masq.MATERIAL_CODE, masq.MATERIAL_DESC, masq.ROLL_TWELVE_MONTH_SALE_QTY, masq.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY, masq.PASS_THREE_MONTH_SALE_QTY, masq.PASS_SIX_MONTH_SALE_QTY, masq.DELIVERY_FREQUENCY, masq.SALE_AREA FROM ( -- 从过滤性最好的表开始 SELECT DISTINCT STRUCTURE_NAME FROM T_MP_STRUCTURE_ALLOCATION WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND `YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND `MONTH` = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND IS_DELETE = 0 ) filtered_structures INNER JOIN t_mdm_material_info mi ON mi.STRUCTURE_NAME = filtered_structures.STRUCTURE_NAME AND mi.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN T_MDM_MONTH_AVG_SALE_QTY masq ON masq.MATERIAL_CODE = mi.MATERIAL_CODE AND masq.IS_DELETE = 0
